tools.description: Read stored cards from Contacts, in the name order chosen in Contacts settings unless orderBy says otherwise. Cards are returned as stored, not unified: a person with cards in two accounts is two results that name each other in linkedContactIdentifiers. Fields follow CNContact. Results come from the Contacts framework without launching Contacts, unless include, a date filter, a date order, or the NOTE key asks for what only Contacts scripting provides. Filters intersect; empty arrays match nothing. Cursor is the next page offset; keep the criteria and limit unchanged across pages.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

contactTypes.description: Match any of these types; [] matches nothing.

containerIdentifiers.description: Match cards stored in any of these containers.

createdBefore.description: Created before this instant; same forms and cost as createdFrom.

createdFrom.description: Created at or after this instant: an RFC 3339 timestamp, or YYYY-MM-DD for that day's midnight in the host zone. Creation dates are read from Contacts through scripting, which launches Contacts when it is not running.

customLabels.description: Match cards that do, or do not, have an entry with a custom label. Social profiles and instant message addresses are not counted: their labels name the service.

groupIdentifiers.description: Match cards that belong to any of these groups.

has.description: Match cards that have a value for every one of these keys. NOTE is read from Contacts through scripting, which launches Contacts when it is not running.

identifiers.description: Match any of these cards; [] matches nothing.

labels.description: Match cards with an entry carrying any of these labels: a stored token, a custom label, or a built-in label's word such as home, work, mobile, or other.

linked.description: Match cards Contacts does, or does not, show together with another card.

missing.description: Match cards that have no value for any of these keys.

modifiedBefore.description: Last changed before this instant; same forms and cost as createdFrom.

modifiedFrom.description: Last changed at or after this instant; same forms and cost as createdFrom.

query.description: Case- and accent-insensitive substring of any name, the organization, department, job title, an email address, URL, postal address, profile, or related name. A query with three or more digits also matches phone numbers, whatever their punctuation.

include.description: Fields to add that only Contacts scripting provides: NOTE, CREATION_DATE, MODIFICATION_DATE. Asking for any launches Contacts when it is not running and needs Automation access; omitted, the result comes from the Contacts framework alone.

limit.description: Maximum items in the page, from 1 through 100; defaults to 50.

direction.description: ASC or DESC; defaults to ASC.

field.description: What to sort by. USER_DEFAULT is the name order chosen in Contacts settings; a card without the value sorts last. CREATION_DATE and MODIFICATION_DATE are read from Contacts through scripting, which launches Contacts when it is not running.
